configurations.name: agency-os-e2e-local
runtimeArgs: set AGENCY_OS_LOCAL_MODE=1&& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m streamlit run app.py --server.headless true --server.port 8503

configurations.name: agency-os-e2e-bridged
runtimeArgs: $env:AGENCY_OS_LOCAL_MODE='1'; $env:SUPABASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:3002'; $env:CLAUDE_PROVIDER_URL='http://127.0.0.1:3111'; $env:CLAUDE_PROVIDER_SECRET=(((docker inspect ppc-manager --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}') | Select-String '^CLAUDE_PROVIDER_SECRET=') -join '').Substring(23); $env:SUPABASE_KEY=(((docker inspect ppc-manager --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}') | Select-String '^SUPABASE_KEY=') -join '').Substring(13); .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m streamlit run app.py --server.headless true --server.port 8504
